notes: Corrected ton loipon: the accepted alignment left the article unrepresented and gave other kind to the adjective under rule 17. Rule 102 scopes that clause to anarthrous Greek and gives a supplied nominal to the article wherever one governs the phrase, so the article takes kind and the adjective is left bare.
ei tychoi still split, the particle unrepresented; a single noncompositional unit is barred by rule 94's single-word precondition.
